answer: None — as a Vietnamese citizen, you don't need a visa to enter Vietnam. Just travel on your valid Vietnamese passport; no e-Visa, visa-on-arrival, or exemption paperwork applies to you (those are only for foreign passport holders). Data as of 2026-08-17 — worth a quick check at https://evisa.gov.vn/ if anything about your citizenship/documentation status is unusual, but for a standard Vietnamese national returning home, no visa is required.
